run_bm_raymarching: run the bm_raymarching benchmark to measure raymarching performance across varying ray and point counts
test_EmissionAbsorptionRaymarcher: test the EmissionAbsorptionRaymarcher by rendering features, depths, and opacities from ray densities and features
test_AbsorptionOnlyRaymarcher: test the AbsorptionOnlyRaymarcher by rendering opacities from ray densities and checking differentiability
benchmark_raymarcher: benchmark raymarching performance using fvcore benchmark with EmissionAbsorptionRaymarcher and AbsorptionOnlyRaymarcher across grid parameters
review_TestRaymarching_raymarcher: review the TestRaymarching raymarcher static method that generates random rays and runs a raymarcher for benchmarking
